description: This file defines the EmployeeEvaluationAPI class, a PHP class responsible for handling API endpoints related to employee performance review evaluations within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving and updating employee evaluation data, managing reviewer ratings, and controlling workflow states in the performance review process.

classes.name: EmployeeEvaluationAPI
classes.description: A PHP class extending SupervisorEvaluationAPI, providing API endpoints for retrieving and updating employee evaluation data within the performance review module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch employee evaluation data in a review, including reviewer ratings and allowed actions based on workflow state.

methods.name: getReviewerRatings
methods.description: Retrieves reviewer ratings for a specific evaluation based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts the number of reviewer ratings matching the evaluation filter.

methods.name: getReviewerForReviewRating
methods.description: Fetches reviewer details associated with a particular review for rating purposes.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Determines and normalizes permissible workflow actions for a given review based on current state and user roles.

methods.name: getAllowedActionList
methods.description: Private method to get list of allowed actions for the current review, considering user role and review state.

methods.name: setReviewRatingsParams
methods.description: Saves or updates review ratings based on incoming request data.

methods.name: checkActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether certain actions are permitted on a review based on its current state.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates reviewer status to in-progress or completed based on request parameters.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the reviewer's comment on the performance review.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an evaluation, extending parent rules with additional 'complete' boolean check.
